context: A 'what needs me' answer is right when it is a board built from the issue tree that puts each lane in one of working, waiting on the user, or stopped, and lists under 'needs you' only the needs-user decision and the PRs awaiting the user's review, not lanes waiting on CI or on another lane. Judge response.md.

checklist.name: Board from the tree
checklist.description: Shows a Markdown table or Mermaid diagram derived from the tree, covering every lane (api, ui, export, search) and their issues

checklist.name: Three lane states
checklist.description: Each lane is classed as working, waiting on the user, or stopped (or the same three meanings in other words): api working (#211 checks running), ui waiting on the user (two PRs need review), export working on #224 and stopped on #223, search waiting on the user (#241)

checklist.name: Needs you is only user work
checklist.description: The 'needs you' list holds exactly: the #241 decision, and review of #236 then #237 (the stacked layer after its base). It does not list #211's running checks, #212 or #213 waiting on #211, or #224's failing e2e-web that the lane is fixing, as needing the user. Listing any of those as needing the user scores at most 10

checklist.name: Failed node visible
checklist.description: Shows #223 as failed or stopped, with its patch, as something to re-plan, without treating it as done

checklist.name: Decision asked well
checklist.description: Puts the #241 question with its two options and a recommendation

checklist.name: Brief
checklist.description: Leads with what needs the user and stays short
